bio: 🔮I am Skia the Minotaur Sorceress and my Obsidian Chateau in the Labyrinth is a pleasant place for weary travelers such as yourselves. Come in: get a fortune reading, let me make you a healing potion and we can discuss your adventures over tea. You are safe here, Darling. Breathe easy now🔮
